note: The colours your game tells apart and what the colour-blind setting switches them to. python tools/access/colour_check.py pairs checks every pair under protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia (SOP-20). min_delta_e: CIEDE2000 a pair needs as that player sees it (20 is the kit's starting point, a tip: raise it if playtesters mix pairs up). filter: true when a mode has no palette here and the game runs the kit's colour-blind filter over the screen instead. Colour is never the only cue: add a shape, icon or label.
